name: Ron
source:
Field of Study: Theology 

Ron isn’t a student at your school. So why did he turn up at your dorm to ask your roommate, Julian, for a huge favor? Why can’t he just return to the Catholic School for Boys? Something tells me Julian’s best friend is running from a past that is darker than his cheery smile would suggest.
